parameters:
Speaking of the Shibagumi, it's demon masks...
Apparently, these were originally meant to
display strength.
list._original:
柴組と言えば鬼面……
これは元々、強さを誇示するためのものだったらしい。

parameters:
And they say the name Shibagumi also comes from
a famous oni monster, "Hyakushiba Oni." The old
squad members sure liked... oni.
list._original:
そして柴組という名前も有名な鬼の怪異
「百王柴鬼」に由来するんだそうだ。
昔の隊士、好きだったんだな……鬼。

parameters:
You... you're thinking, "These guys don't have
to wear their demon masks?" Right?! That's what
you're thinking, isn't it?!
list._original:
お前……
「こいつら鬼面を被らなくていいのか」って思ってるな！？
そうなんだろう！？

parameters:
I'll tell you: they don't have to! During
breaks!
list._original:
答えてやろう、被らなくていいのだ！
休憩中は！

parameters:
Just between you and me, this oni mask gets
stuffy. I'd rather not wear it if I can help it!
list._original:
ここだけの話、鬼面は蒸れる。
できれば被りたくないぞ！

parameters:
Since Shipwatch Fort is in a place like this,
bringing in food supplies is a real pain.
Honestly.
list._original:
舟観砦ってこんな場所にあるものだからさ、
食糧を運び込むのも大変なんだよ。
本当に。

parameters: Oh! So many oni masks on the shelves.
list._original:
おおっ。
棚の中に鬼面がたくさん。
